list: The official 55-trophy PlayStation 5 list, as published at launch
about: Leonida Legend is a complete trophy guide and tracker for Grand Theft Auto VI. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official ones PlayStation publishes; every guide below is written for this entry and names its sources. Kinds: story, collectibles, activities, misc. There are no online trophies in the official list: the partner in the co-op-flavoured trophies is the game's second protagonist, controlled in single player.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; there is nothing to do for this one directly. Plan your run around the long pole, A Long Road (100% completion), and use the roadmap in this guide: story first, then strands and activities, then the collectible sweep, then money and feats, then the 100% mop-up. If exactly one trophy is missing at the end, it is almost always a counter trophy (stunts, cards, WAiNK spots), so check the counters in the tracker before assuming a bug.
trophies.sources: Trophy name, description and grade: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Roadmap structure: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It plays as the game's prologue in the Leonida Keys and teaches movement, driving and the basics of the wanted system, so simply play it through to the end; the trophy unlocks as the mission closes. It cannot be missed: it is the first thing the story asks you to do, and like every story mission it can be replayed later from the mission menu if you ever want to revisit it.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Mission context: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 1, the campaign's first act, which moves Lucia from release day in the Keys up to Vice City and introduces Jason. Chapter trophies are pure story progression: follow the letter markers on the map, finish the chapter's final mission, and the trophy unlocks during the chapter-end sequence. Nothing in Chapter 1 is missable, and no choice in it locks any other trophy.
trophies.sources: Chapter requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Chapter structure: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 2. The chapter leans into the Vice City drug trade (the censored name is exactly how PlayStation publishes it), and its missions are the ones that unlock several of the named story trophies below, such as Breakfast Run and The Cartel Heist. Keep a manual save at the chapter break: it costs nothing and gives you a clean return point if you later want to re-attempt a mission-specific feat.
trophies.sources: Chapter requirement and published name: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Mission order: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 3, the act that opens Vice City up in full, including the VCIA airport and the Ocean Beach strip. Two opportunity trophies live in this part of the game: Catch Me If You Can is tied to a departure at VCIA, so when the story takes you through the airport, take the unscheduled way out instead of the scripted one (see that trophy's guide). Otherwise this is straight story progression and cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: Chapter requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Linked opportunity trophy: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 4, the final full chapter before the endgame sequence. Before starting its last missions, make a separate manual save: the finale is close after this chapter, and a pre-finale save is the cheapest insurance for the choice-based trophy Actions Speak Louder, whose outcome depends on decisions the story remembers. The chapter trophy itself is unmissable story progression.
trophies.sources: Chapter requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Save advice: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide and roadmap.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the campaign's final mission and the trophy unlocks as the credits sequence begins. The game warns you before the point of no return; heed it if any flagged missable is still open (Actions Speak Louder above all), because those are settled by what you do in the finale. After the credits you are returned to free roam with mission replay available, so every non-choice trophy can still be cleaned up afterwards. One of only two gold trophies on the list, and the natural end of step 1 of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Finale requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Point-of-no-return behaviour: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run, an early Chapter 2 job that has the pair moving product across the Keys before the heat arrives. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks through normal progression and can be replayed from the mission menu afterwards. If you are chasing a clean first pass, keep the vehicle intact on the causeway stretch: the mission is timed by the delivery, not by combat, and arriving with the cargo is what the completion check cares about.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Mission placement: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, the Chapter 2 set-piece in which Jason and Lucia rob a cartel money operation. It is a scripted story heist with its own planning board: pick the loud or quiet approach as you prefer, because the trophy only asks for completion, not for a clean or undetected run (the stealth robbery trophy, Sneakthief, is a separate free-roam feat). Finish the escape and lose the wanted level to close the mission.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Heist structure: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play, a Lucia-focused mission built around family in the Keys. Pure story progression: start it from the mission marker, play through its beats, and the trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen. It is worth doing on your first pass through the chapter rather than in replay, because the mission also introduces a contact whose side content feeds the Strangers & Freaks strands later.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Mission placement: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners, the campaign's concert-and-crowd set-piece. It is a named story mission, so it arrives through normal progression and stays available in mission replay afterwards. The mission's loudest section is a vehicle chase scored by survival rather than speed: stay in the vehicle, use the partner's cover fire, and the completion (and trophy) follows at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Mission placement: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport operation at Vice City International. Because it is set at VCIA, it is also your most reliable chance at Catch Me If You Can: that trophy asks for an unscheduled departure at the same airport, and doing it during a story visit saves a separate infiltration later. The mission trophy itself needs only completion, by any approach, and it remains in mission replay.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Linked opportunity trophy: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, the campaign's big set-piece raid. Named story mission, unmissable, replayable afterwards. It is one of the longest combat missions in the story, so go in with full health, armour and snacks for both characters; the trophy is awarded for completion on any difficulty and with any number of retries inside the mission's checkpoints.
trophies.sources: Mission requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Mission placement: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion tracker, shown in the pause menu: story missions, the stranger strands, hobbies and pastimes, random events and the tracked collectibles all feed the percentage, and the game shows each category's share so you can see exactly what is left. This is the longest trophy on the list and the reason the roadmap ends with a mop-up step: do not grind it early, because story and strand play fills most of the bar naturally. When you stall in the high nineties, the missing points are almost always untracked-feeling items the menu does list: finished strands, one activity type never tried (Master of None), and the last collectible sets.
trophies.sources: Completion requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Completion categories: PSNProfiles, GTA VI 100% completion checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps across Leonida: the ramps, billboards, drawbridges and construction props the game counts as stunts, each registering once when you land the jump cleanly on wheels. The in-game stats page tracks the count, and a stunt only counts on a clean landing, so if a jump does not tick the counter, re-run it slower rather than faster. Work region by region after the story, when fast travel and good vehicles are available: Vice City's causeways and the Keys' bridges hold dense clusters. This is a marathon counter, not a skill wall: budget it across the whole cleanup phase instead of one sitting.
trophies.sources: Stunt count: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Stunt tracking: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list; routing advice: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Start every distinct activity type the game offers at least once: races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, meditation spots, hunting and the stunt set among them. You only have to try each type, not win or finish it, which makes this the cheapest trophy on the list and a good early one: sampling everything in your first free-roam hours also unlocks the map knowledge the later counters need. The activity list in the pause menu shows which types you have already touched; the trophy pops when the last untouched type is started.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Activity types: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge: PlayStation tracks 42 of them across the ranges of Leonida, each scored on accuracy and target time with a different weapon class. Gold is about rhythm, not reflexes: learn each course's target order on a silver run first, then chase gold with the weapon's aim-assist snap and short controlled bursts, and never reload mid-string if the course lets you carry a larger magazine instead. Because challenges unlock in tiers, finish the story first so every range and weapon class is open, then clear the ranges one at a time; the tracker in this guide has one row for the trophy, so keep your own count of golds per range in its notes as you go.
trophies.sources: Challenge count (42) and medal requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list), as listed by Exophase. Technique: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one: unlike Earn Cash, Not Kudos, this one is per-location, so a win at one circuit does not excuse another. Drone races are checkpoint time trials against rival times; the winning line is to cut inside the checkpoint gates rather than chase the racing line, and to take the vertical shortcuts the course designers leave over rooftops. Do a sighting lap at each new location, then run the win: the trophy unlocks when your location list is all wins, which the activities menu tracks.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Race format: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: street, off-road, boat and air races all count, but each must be a different event, so re-winning the same circuit does not advance the counter. The cheapest path is to clear the short point-to-point street races first in a fully upgraded car, then take the boat and air events, where the AI fields are weaker. Twenty distinct wins is fewer than the full race calendar, so you can skip the long endurance events entirely; the stats page shows your distinct-win count.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Race categories: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the Keys fisherman, in one of his fishing challenges: speak to him at his spot after fishing is introduced, accept the challenge, and land the heavier catch inside the time limit. Fishing is a timing minigame of casting to the splashing water and playing the fish against its runs; the challenge is won on total weight, so prioritise the big shadows over quick small catches. If Cal wins a round, the challenge can simply be retaken on the spot; nothing about it is missable.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Character and activity context: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one full game on any arcade cabinet: the cabinets in Vice City's bars and the boardwalk arcade run short retro games, and 'complete' means finishing the cabinet's game to its own end screen, not just playing a credit. Pick the shortest cabinet game on offer, finish it in one sitting (cabinet games do not save mid-run), and the trophy unlocks at the game's completion screen. Trying a cabinet also ticks the arcade type for Master of None, so do this during your activity tour.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Activity context: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand: work through every mission Andy gives you, in order, until his final mission appears, then complete it. Strand missions unlock in sequence and each is marked on the map with Andy's initial once available; a strand can stall if the next mission needs a time of day or a story chapter to pass, so if Andy's marker vanishes, advance the clock and the story and check again. Strands stay available after the finale, so this is cleanup-safe. It also counts toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Strand structure: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Kenton's strand is the boating one (the name is a Jaws joke, and so is the mission): bring a seaworthy boat to his markers rather than swimming out, and expect the finale to be set on the water around the Keys. As with every strand, missions arrive in order and remain available after the story, and finishing Kenton advances the 8-strand count for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Strand structure: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand: complete each of Billy's missions as they unlock and then his final one, a solo rider's run that is best attempted on a fast bike you already handle well. Strand progression is sequential and post-story safe; if Billy's next marker does not appear, his strand is gated by story progress or time of day, so push the campaign forward and return. Completing Billy also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Strand structure: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete the full mission strands of 8 different strangers anywhere in Leonida. The six named strand trophies on this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone among them) are five of your eight; the game offers more strands than the trophy needs, so pick the remaining ones up as their markers appear during free roam rather than hunting a specific set. A strand counts only when its final mission is done, not when it is started. The strands are also a required slice of the 100% completion tracker, so this silver is on the critical path for A Long Road.
trophies.sources: Strand count: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Named strands: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list; completion weight: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Randy's strand is built around moving goods, so its missions reward a roomy vehicle and a route planned before the timer starts; the finale is a delivery under pressure, and arriving with the cargo intact is the completion condition. The strand is sequential, available after the story, and counts toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Strand structure: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Tyrone's strand revolves around Vice City's car scene, so expect driving and vehicle-delivery beats and bring a car you do not mind denting. Work his markers in order as they appear; like all strands it persists after the finale and cannot be missed, and it counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Strand structure: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in the state: marked scenic points (beaches at dawn, hilltops, the Keys' quiet piers) where the Meditate prompt appears; sitting through the short sequence once per spot is all that is asked. Spots are a collectible set, so sweep them region by region with the rest of the collectible pass, and use the in-game collectibles counter to confirm the set is complete. A spot can only be used in calm conditions in game terms: if the prompt does not appear, you are likely wanted or in combat, so break line of sight and return.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Collectible set behaviour: PowerPyx, GTA VI collectibles guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he names: Bret is the hunting contact, and his target is a one-off specimen (a named gator in the Grassrivers is the usual first request) rather than a species count. Track it from his marker at dawn or dusk when animal activity peaks, use a scoped rifle from downwind, and one clean kill completes the request; a spooked target respawns on a later day, so a failed stalk is not a miss. Trying hunting also ticks that type for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Hunting context: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full sets of the collectible playing cards scattered across Leonida: cards are found in themed suits at landmarks, interiors and stunt locations, and the collectibles menu shows each set's progress card by card. Three sets is well short of the full deck, so choose the sets whose cards cluster in regions you are already sweeping for other collectibles, and leave the isolated cards for the 100% pass (the full deck feeds A Long Road, but this trophy does not). Cards glow faintly and chime at close range; most interiors on the card list are enterable at any hour.
trophies.sources: Set requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Card set structure: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list; locations framework: PowerPyx, GTA VI collectibles guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use a WAiNK machine at 100 different locations: WAiNK is the in-world cash-machine network, and 'WAiNK It' is simply withdrawing or checking at the machine until the interaction completes; the same machine never counts twice. Machines sit in banks, convenience stores, gas stations and hotel lobbies all over Leonida, so this counter fills naturally if you make a habit of using every machine you pass during the collectible sweep. The stats page tracks unique locations; if you stall in the nineties, the machines you are missing are the interior ones (casino floor, airport terminal, mall), not the street ones.
trophies.sources: Location count: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Machine distribution: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges: the rotating skill challenges (driving lines, weapon feats, exploration and stunt tasks) listed on the challenges page of the pause menu. Fifty is a subset of the full challenge board, so pick the short repeatable ones (near-miss chains, wheelie distances, headshot counts) and let the long grinds go. Challenges reward progress during everything else you do, so check the page whenever a session ends and claim the nearly-done ones first; the counter is tracked in the menu, and this trophy usually lands mid-cleanup without a dedicated grind.
trophies.sources: Challenge count: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Challenge system: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While your partner is with you in free roam, raise a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely: commit crimes in view of police until four stars, then break line of sight and hide (alleys, the metro tunnels, a respray) until the stars drain and the 'escaped' state registers with your partner still beside you. The trap is your partner wandering off or being left behind during the chase, so commit the crimes with both characters in the same vehicle and escape in it together. Despite the co-op flavour this is a single-player feat: your partner is the second protagonist, not another player.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Partner mechanic: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, rob three shops in one unbroken wanted sequence: rob the first till, keep the wanted level alive while you drive to the second and third (do not let the stars fully drain between shops, and do not change vehicles into a clean one), and rob each register with your partner in the shop or the getaway car. Convenience stores on the same strip are ideal: pick a row of three on one Vice City avenue, rob them in a line, then escape. If the wanted level drops to zero mid-run the chain resets, so keep committing minor offences in view of patrols between shops.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Shop robbery system: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicle models: a vehicle is discovered the first time you enter it, and the vehicle section of the stats menu keeps the count. Traffic variety rises with story progress and differs by district, so the efficient route is a deliberate tour: airport and port for service vehicles, the Keys for boats and bikes, rich districts for supercars, industrial areas for trucks. Entering is enough: you do not need to own, store or even drive off in them, so a parking-lot walk hopping driver seats fills the counter quickly.
trophies.sources: Vehicle count: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Discovery rule: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the protagonists' slow-motion aiming ability: trigger it with a full meter in a crowd of hostiles and chain headshots before the meter empties. The reliable setup is a gang hideout or a late story shootout where enemies bunch at a doorway; a shotgun or automatic rifle forgives sloppy aim inside the slow-down. If you reach four and the meter dies, build the meter back on the same group and retry: the five must fall inside a single activation, but there is no limit on attempts.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Ability mechanics: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — flagged from its description: at Vice City International Airport, take a plane out without being scheduled to: steal an aircraft from the tarmac or a hangar and take off while the airport responds. The clean chance is during the story's VCIA visits (VCIA Takedown above all): instead of following the scripted exit, break for a parked jet and get airborne. It is flagged missable because the airport's accessible state changes with the story, and a post-game attempt means fighting through a locked-down airfield; if you are past the story, use mission replay of the VCIA mission and depart during it. Any successful takeoff in a stolen plane from VCIA counts; landing is not required.
trophies.sources: Requirement and airport: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Missable assessment and replay route: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description is the clue: the Rhino is the army's tank, and the trophy asks you to make things hot in one: steal a Rhino (they roll out at high wanted levels and sit at the military facilities in the Grassrivers) and cause mayhem until the trophy pops: running up destruction and surviving the response is the substance of it. Enter the tank, keep moving so rockets do not settle on you, and rack up destroyed vehicles; the trophy typically lands within a few minutes of sustained rampage. If the tank is disabled, the attempt simply ends: steal the next one.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Rhino identification: Exophase, GTA VI hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out with no detection: no alarm tripped, no witness call completing, no wanted level. Go at night in a mask with a suppressed approach: case the store, enter through the rear where the layout allows, keep the staff covered without firing, empty the cases and leave by the back before any patrol passes. Detection is binary and unforgiving: a single completed phone call from a witness fails the attempt, so control the room first and loot second. A failed attempt costs nothing but time; the stores restock and can be retried.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Robbery detection rules: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob the vaults of 5 different banks and escape the response each time: bank vaults are the heavy robberies, needing entry gear and a planned exit, and each bank counts once. Work them as a circuit during the money step of the roadmap: case a bank, drill or blast the vault, take the cash and lose the wanted level properly (a death or arrest voids that bank's escape). Five distinct banks, five clean escapes. The money is a bonus: the same robberies feed the laundering and spending trophies, so run them before Dime on the Dollar and Treat Yo Self are finished.
trophies.sources: Vault count: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Bank robbery system: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armoured cash truck and escape with the money: the trucks run bank routes on a schedule and show as moving blips once you have seen one; stop the truck (a heavy vehicle block works better than gunfire), blow the rear doors with explosives or a thermal charge, take the cash and lose the wanted level. The 'classic blitz' of the name is the method: fast stop, doors blown, gone. One truck is enough, and the cash also feeds the laundering counter for Dime on the Dollar.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Truck robbery method: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map of Leonida: the state counts as explored when every region's fog is cleared, which in practice means visiting every district, island and backwater once, including the far Keys and the northern Grassrivers shore. A plane or helicopter tour is the fast way: fly a grid over the state at medium altitude and the map fills in beneath you, then mop up any pocket the flight missed on the ground. This pairs naturally with the collectible sweep, which takes you to most corners anyway; check the map's completion percentage in the pause menu to find the gaps.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Exploration tracking: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation (a drug lab, chop shop or stash business) run by each of Leonida's gangs: the operations appear as gang-coloured territory markers once discovered, and robbing one means clearing its defenders and emptying the safe or stock. Each gang needs exactly one successful hit, so this is a tour, not a grind: identify the gangs from the territory overlay, rob one operation per gang, and escape. Doing these during the money step also stocks Marked Bills for the laundering trophy.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Gang operations: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — flagged from its name and description: 'In The Beginning…' ties this to the game's opening hours, when the story puts you on Ocean Beach; order a cocktail at a beachfront bar on the Ocean Beach strip and drink it where the view is the ocean. The safe play is to do it the first time the story leaves you free on Ocean Beach in Chapter 1: stop at the first open beach bar, buy the cocktail, and the trophy should pop as the drink finishes. If you are reading this late, try the same bars in free roam before assuming the worst, but treat it as an early-game trophy: the roadmap puts it in step 1 for a reason.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Missable assessment: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a descriptive tell: get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the showroom's glass front instead of the door. The luxury dealerships on the Vice City strip keep cars on the floor with the keys in; take one, line up on the window line, and accelerate through it: the trophy pops as you exit through the smashed glass with the car. 'Classic style' is the joke (it is the series' oldest exit), so any showroom car and any window line works; a wanted level afterwards is expected and harmless.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Hidden trophy interpretation: Exophase, GTA VI hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Another hidden one hiding in plain sight: go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the 'follow-through': play a bowling game there and finish it (the phrase is bowling's own, the swing's follow-through). The alley is a working leisure interior, so this is an activity visit: pay for a game, bowl every frame to the end, and the trophy unlocks at the score screen. Bowling also ticks an activity type for Master of None, so fold the visit into the activity tour. (Yes, cousin, the series is doing the joke on purpose.)
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Location naming: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy about the partnership: 'mass appeal' points at the pair's public profile: build Jason and Lucia's joint reputation by completing partner activities together (the paired feats, dates and joint free-roam activities all feed it) until the partnership stat crosses its top tier, at which point the trophy pops. It is deliberately vague because it is a cumulative stat, not a single act: the practical route is to simply do the other partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and the partner side content as a pair rather than solo, and let this land on its own during cleanup.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Partnership stat: PSNProfiles, GTA VI hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one genuinely choice-locked trophy on the list, flagged from its description: the campaign remembers a small number of binary choices (spare or finish, take or refuse), and this trophy is tied to committing to a choice outcome the story tracks. Because a single playthrough can only take one side of a choice, the safe method is the save method: keep a separate manual save before every story decision point from Chapter 4 onward, finish the game on one path, then reload the pre-finale save and take the other side if the trophy has not popped. If you only learn of it after the credits, mission replay of the finale sequence is the fallback, but the manual-save route is the reliable one, which is why the roadmap repeats it at every chapter break.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Missable assessment and save method: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide and roadmap.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description tells you the shape: something must fail once and succeed on the second attempt. In practice it is tied to a repeatable score attack (the ranges and races are the candidates): post a result, fail to beat it, then beat it on the retry. The dependable way to force it: at any shooting range challenge, set a deliberately low first score, then beat it on the immediate second run. If it does not pop there, do the same two-step at a race (finish once, then win the rematch): the trophy is about the pattern, fail then succeed, and it is not missable because both venues are infinitely repeatable.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Interpretation: Exophase, GTA VI hidden trophies.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The series' traditional UFO trophy: a hidden one for witnessing Leonida's unexplained phenomenon. The pattern from the description and the series' habits: be at the remote spot (the Grassrivers swamp and the Mount Kalaga foothills are the state's strange places) at night, in clear weather, after the story, and watch the sky event through to its end without leaving the area. It is an Easter egg, not a task: no counter tracks it, and if nothing happens, return on the next clear night rather than camping the spot. Not missable, and deliberately left vague by every source: half the trophy is seeing it unprepared.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Easter-egg context: PSNProfiles, GTA VI hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy and a pun: knock down a group of pedestrians with a melee attack from a moving vehicle: ride a motorcycle (or hang from a car) past a tight crowd on a sidewalk and swing the melee weapon as you pass; bowling a whole 'rack' of them in one pass is the joke the name is making. The boardwalk crowds on Ocean Beach at midday are the densest target. One solid pass that drops the group earns it; expect a wanted level, which is part of the fun and not a failure state.
trophies.sources: Description as published: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Interpretation: Exophase, GTA VI hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your fence contacts: Marked Bills come from robberies (bank vaults, armoured trucks and gang operations all pay partly in marked cash, which sits in your inventory as dirty money until a contact cleans it at a cut). The counter only tracks money that has passed through the laundering action, not money earned, so the discipline is to launder after every robbery rather than hoarding dirty cash. Run the robbery circuit of step 5 of the roadmap and this lands well before the circuit is done; the contacts' cut means you need to steal noticeably more than $250,000 gross.
trophies.sources: Amount: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Marked Bills system: PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops: clothing, weapons and attachments, vehicle parts, food, services and properties' furnishings all count as shop spending (vehicle purchases from showrooms count too, which is the fast lane: one supercar can be half the trophy). There is no reason to grind this early, when money is tight: by the money step of the roadmap the robberies have made you rich, and outfitting both characters, a garage of cars and full weapon attachments crosses $100,000 in one shopping session. The stats page tracks lifetime shop spend.
trophies.sources: Amount: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Spending categories: Exophase, GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every purchasable garage property in Leonida: garages are the 'For Sale' properties with the garage icon, distinct from safehouses and businesses, and each is bought at its sign once you have the cash. They are spread one or two per district, so this pairs with the exploration trophy: clear the map, buy each garage as you find it. Total cost is a mid-six-figure sum across the set, which the robbery circuit covers; the property list in the pause menu shows owned versus available so you can see which district's garage is still missing.
trophies.sources: Requirement: PlayStation (official PS5 trophy list). Property system: PowerPyx, GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, the in-phone vehicle service: a vehicle is registered by driving it and choosing the register option (in the app or at a Scooter Bros point), which ties it to you for recall and insurance. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the story cars you are given plus the first handful you steal and keep, rather than buying ten. Registration is also genuinely useful (registered vehicles can be delivered back to you), so do this early; it is the lightest collectible-style trophy on the list.
